question: to the Commission Alexander Jungbluth (ESN) Subject:

From 8 to 12 June 2026 in Vienna, an Erasmus+ training course was held on ‘queer youth and allies: building inclusive youth work’, for 30 youth workers to discuss ‘intersectionality’ and how to create ‘more inclusive spaces for queer young people’. 1.
What specific objectives and measurable outcomes did the Commission aim to achieve by funding this course, and to what extent are these in line with the core objectives of EU youth policy?
What was the total cost of this course, including the contributions made by Erasmus+ and the European Solidarity Corps towards accommodation, meals, travel and organisation?

Which organisations and individuals (please provide names) from which countries of origin took part in the course as participants, trainers or cooperation partners (including OeAD, SALTO, WienXtra and Q:WIR), or were involved in shaping its content?
